title: fix: add missing `id` field to dashboard widgets in example apps
body:
`DashboardWidgetSchema` now requires a mandatory `id` field (`SnakeCaseIdentifier`), but the example app dashboards were never updated — breaking the CI build.

- Added `id` to all 36 widgets across 4 dashboard files in `examples/app-crm` and `examples/app-todo`

```ts
// Before
{ title: 'Total Revenue (YTD)', type: 'metric', object: 'opportunity', ... }

// After
{ id: 'total_revenue_ytd', title: 'Total Revenue (YTD)', type: 'metric', object: 'opportunity', ... }
```
